outputs.explanation: Panel A is a mass spectrum (line/peak plot) showing deconvoluted intensity vs. mass; line plots of this kind are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel B is a mass spectrum (line/peak plot) analogous to A; exempt as a line plot.

Bars show the proportion of protein population bound to a given number of metal atoms as derived from a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum (no error bars, no indication of averaged replicates), so this is not a mean-of-replicates plot requiring individual point overlay.
Same type of single-measurement MS-derived proportion bar chart as panel C, with no error bars indicating averaged replicates.
Same type of single-measurement MS-derived proportion bar chart as panel C, with no error bars indicating averaged replicates.
Same type of single-measurement MS-derived proportion bar chart as panel C, with no error bars indicating averaged replicates.

Bars represent per-residue chemical shift perturbation values at discrete metal equivalents (single NMR measurement per residue/condition), not an average across replicates with variability, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
Same type of per-residue CSP bar chart as panel G, representing single measurements rather than averaged replicates.
